profile_text.body:
Fireflies.ai is a Miami, Florida-based company whose product, also called Fireflies.ai, is an AI meeting assistant the company describes as the "#1 AI Teammate for Meetings, Email, Chat & CRM." The service takes notes, manages tasks, and automates workflows across meetings, email, chat, CRM platforms, and other connected apps, and it allows teams to build a searchable knowledge base from their recorded work in one place.

The core product works by inviting an agent identified as fred@fireflies.ai to a live meeting or by having it auto-join calendar meetings to record, transcribe, and summarize conversations. The company also offers what it calls AI Skills, which are described as automations that can extract key details from meetings, generate follow-up emails, score candidates, and surface other insights.

The site's held facts place the company in Florida, which carries a legal-exposure flag of 48 cases associated with that state, though no specific litigation involving Fireflies.ai itself is recorded. The product is categorized under Notes, Knowledge, and Meetings, with a notation that meeting transcription makes consent considerations relevant, a common regulatory issue for services that record conversations.
